stock cooperatives, community apartment projects, hotels, and commercial uses, regardless

fields.note: Demolition/conversion triggering relocation assistance regardless of RSO/JCO is stated, and the condominium-conversion tentative map election and continued payment duty are also in the FAQ. The bulletin lists this under not-at-fault evictions requiring relocation assistance, so the payment obligation is supported.
Key value is null. The document gives amounts for general RSO/JCO no-fault evictions but ties none specifically to LAMC 47.06/47.07 demolition or conversion, so nothing is stated for this rule.
Effective date is null. The document states no effective date for LAMC 47.06/47.07. The July 1, 2026 dates apply only to the amount charts.
